SRC-348:R001.text: A new actionable attachment must route through START, not status or continue; preserve the original task bytes and refuse clearly when attachment transport is unavailable

SRC-348:R002.text: A requirement disposition must be canonically validated: a test-run PASS is not a requirement VERIFIED, terminal dispositions require clause-specific evidence, and evidence that is absent, unrelated or a blanket aggregate may not verify a clause

SRC-348:R003.text: Under a blocked or reauthentication-required gate, strictly read-only investigation is permitted and every state-changing bypass is prohibited; CLI replay of operator ingress must fail and authenticated operator-carrier ingress must be verified
